summary: Frontend-only Ads regression testing completed. App boots cleanly, /ads/create and /ads/review routes load without red-screen/runtime crashes, and review shows clean unauthorized state when not admin. Auth-gated Ads tab browsing could not be reached in automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Unauthenticated automation session is redirected to sign-in, so Ads tab browse/my-ads experience and bottom-tab rendering with authenticated state could not be validated end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Submitting Create Ad triggered console error '[CONVEX M(ads:create)] Server Error'. Route remains stable, but mutation path is not cleanly handled for unauthenticated web automation state.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist: expo-notifications web listener support warning, shadow* deprecation warning, pointerEvents deprecation warning.

action_items: Verify authenticated Ads tab flow manually/with controllable auth harness: tab visibility, segmented Browse Ads/My Ads behavior, and navigation regressions in bottom tabs.
Handle unauthenticated create submission path explicitly (e.g., auth gate or user-facing unauthorized state) to avoid raw Convex server error logging.
Retest /ads and tab-ads after auth automation is available to confirm no tab regression from Ads module wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: app/ads/create.tsx and app/ads/review.tsx are directly routable while ads tab is auth-gated in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, creating inconsistent auth behavior across Ads entry points.
CountrySelectorModal testIDs include raw country names (e.g., country-option-United States), which can be brittle for automation due to spaces/special characters.
Create form helper Field uses props:any, reducing type safety for required input props in a critical submission route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file exists at /app/memory/test_credentials.md and contains OIDC/Google-based account guidance. /app/auth_testing.md and /app/auth-testing.md are missing. This run validated route stability for /ads/create and /ads/review only in unauthenticated web automation.
rca_of_issue: Repro: Open /ads/create as unauthenticated user, fill required fields, tap ad-submit-button. Observed console error: [CONVEX M(ads:create)] Server Error; UI stays on create-ad-screen. Likely cause: direct create route allows access without upfront auth guard, and backend mutation rejects unauthenticated request. Mitigation: add consistent auth guard or explicit unauthorized handling before mutation call.
